lines:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Codex
    participant QAAPI as QA MCP API
    participant Runtime as QA Execution Runtime
    participant Store as QA Store and Run Evidence
    Codex->>QAAPI: list jobs by state tag task or design link
    QAAPI->>Store: query qa_jobs and latest qa_job_runs
    Store-->>QAAPI: matching jobs with derived state
    QAAPI-->>Codex: deterministic job list
    Codex->>QAAPI: run matching jobs
    QAAPI->>Runtime: run query-selected jobs
    Runtime->>Store: create qa_runs group
    loop each matching job
        Runtime->>Store: store qa_job_runs output and result
    end
    Runtime->>Store: update qa_runs summary
    Runtime-->>QAAPI: run summary and job results
    QAAPI-->>Codex: QA run evidence

data.title: QA MCP Query and Run Sequence
